title: Solomon builds the temple on Mount Moriah
description: Solomon begins building the house of the Lord on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem, where the Lord had appeared to David, at the threshing floor of the Jebusite Ornan. He builds the porch, the main hall, and the Most Holy Place, covering everything with fine gold and precious stones. He makes two cherubim of cast metal for the Most Holy Place and a curtain embroidered with cherubim. In front of the temple he erects two pillars which he names Jakin and Boaz.
